intro: Lard, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, is hungry and frightened. A Vilebranch struck Lard during a private picnic, and Lard fled without lunch. You are asked to fetch it from an island to the north.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lard was at secret special spot having picnic when ugly mean Vilebranch hit Lard wit da big stick. Lard run back to Revantusk but forget Lard lunch. Lard hungry. Maybe you go back to secret special spot and get Lard lunch? Lard scared. Go nort! Island der to da nort is da secret special spot.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Lard takes the huge haunch of meat from you and stuffs it in his face.
Dis hit da spot! Tanks little one.
Lard make you special picnic basket for help Lard.
